Rationale: a ⛔ note whose stated reason has been removed (#12533's alias hop) is a doc-integrity defect either way, and behavior is identical under both resolutions, so this is lane discretion rather than a maintainer decision. Dispatch guidance: the floor deliverable is rewriting both notes to state the reason that still holds; actually consuming the hop (single-sourcing the organizations package spelling) is the lane PM's explicit ruling at dispatch time and must move all four sites named in the body together, including retiring the site-8 equality pin along with its subject. Serial constraint: same file surface as in-flight #12533 — dispatch after its PR lands and re-verify both notes on the merged ref. Escalate only if implementation surfaces a live reason the duplication must stay that neither card records.

## ⏸️ Held one more merge — and the reason is worth writing down, because the tempting move is wrong

`domain:cli` seat (#6024), session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd`. ⛔ Not claiming yet.

### The premise is now confirmed live

[PR #12582](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12582) (#12533) merged as **`1ca763b60`**. Measured on `origin/main` @ `e2d1f8001`: `resolveImportedLiteral` appears **5×** in `serve-cluster-host-resolution.test.ts`. ⇒ **the hop is real and on main**, and the constraint this card is about has genuinely moved.

And the stale clause is exactly where you said, verbatim at `serve-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts:52–58`:

> *"…resolves the organizations `import()` through that static and **needs the literal in that file, or the load drops out of the host-anchoring sweep silently**"*

⭐ That last clause is now **false**. And a ⛔ prohibition whose stated reason is false is worse than no note: the next author reads it as arbitrary and steps over it. ⚠️ It is the same defect class this lane has filed four cards on this round (#12498, #12561, #12563, #12618 — *a true refusal carrying a false explanation*), one level up: **a true prohibition carrying a false explanation.**

### ⛔ Why the note-repair half is NOT dispatchable yet, even though it looks unfenced

The obvious move is to split off the note repair — it needs no maintainer decision, and two of the three sites are free:

| site | state |
| :--- | :--- |
| `serve-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts:52–58` | **free** |
| `packages/cli/src/utils/tenancy-posture-hints.ts:89` | **free** |
| `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` docblock (~`:526`) — *"its docblock says why"*, i.e. it carries the same reason | ⛔ **HELD by [PR #12621](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12621)** |

⇒ shipping now repairs **two of three** copies of one stale reason and leaves the third standing — in the file the other two **cite as the authority** (*"its docblock says why"*).

⭐ **That is precisely the failure #12561 was filed for**: two false paragraphs in one docblock, found from opposite directions a day apart, because the first repair did not sweep the reason it was fixing. ⛔ Filling a dispatch slot with a partial repair of a *citation chain* is how this lane generates its own next duplicate card.

⇒ **Held until [PR #12621](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12621) merges** (un-drafted, awaiting checks). Then all three move in one diff.

### For whoever takes it

⭐ **Two forks, and only one needs the maintainer:**

1. **The note repair** — unambiguous, needed under *either* outcome, ⛔ not a maintainer call. All three copies, one diff.
2. **The reversal** (single-source the literal, delete site 8) — **maintainer-facing**, because [PR #12532](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12532) shipped the duplication *deliberately* with reasoning at both ends.

⛔ Do not let 2 block 1. ⭐ And doing 1 first makes 2 **easier to decide**, because the note will then state the reason that actually survives the hop instead of the one that no longer does.

⚠️ `tenancy-posture-hints.ts:89` points the **other direction** (don't import *from* `serve.ts` *into* the shared module). ⛔ Do not assume it falls with the other — re-read its reasoning on its own terms and say what you concluded.

⛔ And site 8 stays until the reversal is actually taken: it pins the two declarations equal, and while there are two declarations that pin has a subject.

## ⏸️ Still held — the fence moved, it did not open

`domain:cli` seat (#6024), session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd`.

[PR #12621](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12621) merged as **`0043c9224`**, so `serve.ts` is released from *that* holder — and my own check-in said this card and **#12540** were *"disjoint from each other"* and could both be dispatched.

⛔ **That was wrong, and re-deriving caught it before executing.**

| card | files |
| :--- | :--- |
| **#12540** (now dispatched) | `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (~`:3348`, `:3375`) · `serve-cluster-host-resolution.test.ts` |
| **#12579** (this card) | `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (the `ORGANIZATIONS_RUNTIME_PKG` docblock) · `serve-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts` · `tenancy-posture-hints.ts` |

⇒ **both touch `serve.ts`.** Ruling ① is *same file HARD SERIAL, **no region exemption*** — different regions of one file is exactly the case the "no region exemption" clause exists to refuse. ⇒ **held behind #12540.**

⭐ Banking it plainly, because this is the **second** time this round a refill map of mine claimed a disjointness that measurement refused (the first said #12543 / #12533 / #12540 could go "three at once"): **a refill map is a plan written before the fences were measured. Re-derive from each card's real surface at dispatch time — a map that says "disjoint" is a hypothesis, not a permission.**

### ⚠️ And the anchors in this card are already stale

Re-measured on `origin/main` @ `0043c9224`, against what the card body records:

| | card says | **now** |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| `UNRESOLVABLE_HOST_LOADS` | `:486` | **`:666`** |
| the both-directions `'pkg'` pin | `:936` | **`:1116`** |
| `loadOptionalServicePlugin` callers | `:3275` / `:3302` | **`:3348` / `:3375`** |

⛔ Whoever takes this re-derives everything and cites quoted phrases, not lines.

**Everything else in comment `5432919462` still stands** — dispatch WHOLE, all three copies of the stale reason in one diff, ⛔ do not let the maintainer-facing reversal block the note repair, ⚠️ `tenancy-posture-hints.ts:89` points the other direction and gets its own reading, ⛔ site 8 stays until the reversal is actually taken.

## ✅ ACCEPT — [PR #12636](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12636), fork (a)

Reviewed against GitHub (the diff, the check runs, the tree), not against the report. Four files, `+91/−52`, every hunk inside a docblock. Verified on `40ce969b1`.

### ⚠️ The census in my card was wrong, and the dev's is right — FOUR copies, not three

I wrote three. There were four. The one I missed is `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts:31-32`, and it is the same dead reason one file further along the same citation chain:

> *"…which must stay a string LITERAL in `serve.ts` or the host-anchoring sweep in `serve-cluster-host-resolution.test.ts` can no longer resolve which package that command's `import()` names."*

**Mechanism of my error, since it is the reusable part:** I enumerated by grepping for the phrasing I remembered from the two sites I had already read (`drops out of the host-anchoring sweep`, `string LITERAL in this file`). That finds the copies that share my sample's wording and is blind to a paraphrase — and site 4 is a paraphrase. The dev enumerated the other way round: grep the reason's *fingerprints* (`re-export of`, `silent-vacuity`, `one more hop` / `one further hop`, `LITERAL IN THAT FILE`), then reverse-check every hit against `ORGANIZATIONS_RUNTIME_PKG`, a term known present in all of them. That is a census; mine was a sample.

⭐ It also matters that the dev **took site 4 into the diff rather than reporting it back**: repairing three of four would have reproduced exactly the split-brain this card exists to end, under ruling ①'s own logic. Correct call, made without being asked.

Banked for this seat: **a census of "how many places say X" is not complete until each hit is reverse-checked against a term the population must contain.** Second time this round that re-deriving beat recall (cf. #12567's `finish()`).

### Rulings, answered

**③ `tenancy-posture-hints.ts` — accepted, and the reading is right.** The ⛔ there (*"Do NOT close the gap by importing `Serve.ORGANIZATIONS_RUNTIME_PKG` here instead"*) rests on #12464's coupling-direction ruling — `os doctor` must not depend on a `serve` command's export to spell a package name — which the resolver hop does not touch. Kept verbatim, including the connective *"instead"*, whose referent (the paragraph above about ending the duplication for real) is repaired in place rather than deleted, so the connective still has a subject. The two paragraphs *around* it were stale and both are repaired — including *"…was in flight elsewhere when this landed"*, which the hop's landing made false. I did not ask for that second one; it is the same defect and belongs in the same diff.

**⑤ — accepted as measured.** No reason survives for the literal living in `serve.ts` **specifically**: the sweep is the only thing in the tree that reads that file's *source* for a package spelling, and the three other readers (roster key, site 8, doctor's leg (ii)) read the *value* and are alias-safe. The notes now say that plainly instead of asserting a prohibition — which was the whole point of the card. Recording the dead reason **as history rather than deleting it** is the right shape: a reader who meets neither half re-derives it from the duplication and puts the ⛔ back.

**Site 8 stays.** Correct, and for the stated reason: while there are two declarations the pin has a subject, so it falls with its subject or not at all. Deleting it belongs to the reversal, not to this repair.

### The two open questions

**(1) Fork (b) — actually single-sourcing the spelling: ⛔ NOT this seat's to rule.** [PR #12532](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12532) shipped the duplication deliberately with reasoning written at both ends; reversing a deliberate decision is maintainer-facing, and no amount of "it is now possible" converts it into a dispatchable card. It stays open here. **This card is hereby scoped down to fork (b) only** — fork (a) is discharged by this PR; do not re-dispatch the note repair.

**(2) `Part of #12579` instead of `Fixes`: upheld — the deviation was correct.** Closing the card would leave four freshly-written docblocks citing a closed issue as the place the decision is open, and would drop the live half out of every `is:open` filter. The repo agrees with the dev, mechanically: the **`Part-of PR must not also close its card`** check is green on this head. Flagging it rather than silently picking one is the behaviour I want.

### Verification I ran myself

- **Comment-only** — confirmed by reading all four patches: every hunk is inside a `/** … */`. The dev's independent proof (both blobs transpiled `removeComments: true`, emitted program hashed, all four EQUAL) is worth more than the eyeball for one reason: **the instrument is reverse-checked in both directions** — a code token moved the hash, a comment token did not. An equality from an uncalibrated instrument is not evidence; this one is calibrated.
- **The sweep itself was run.** `serve-cluster-host-resolution.test.ts` reads both edited source files *as text*, so it is the one suite a comment edit could plausibly break. It is in the 4-file / 64-test green, and the narrowing was declared rather than passed off as a full run.
- **`pnpm lint` full-repo, exit 0, no narrowing claimed.**
- Check runs on `40ce969b1`: **zero red**, the rest still in flight. Arming on green, not on the report.

`skip-changeset` is right — the emitted program is byte-identical, so it releases nothing.

## 📌 Re-scoped to fork (b) — fork (a) is discharged. `needs-user-decision`, unassigned

`domain:cli` seat (#6024). [PR #12636](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12636) merged as **`616a4571c`**. `pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`; unassigned.

### Done — fork (a), the note repair

All **four** copies of the dead reason now state it as history and say what actually survives: `serve.ts`, `utils/tenancy-posture-hints.ts`, `serve-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts`, and `doctor-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts` — the fourth found by the dev's own census after mine came back three. ⛔ **Do not re-dispatch the note repair.**

### Open — fork (b), and it is a maintainer's call

**Should `Serve.ORGANIZATIONS_RUNTIME_PKG` stop being a duplicated string literal and be sourced from the shared hints module?**

What is settled, so the decision is cheap:

- ⭐ **Nothing forbids it any more.** The constraint that did — the host-anchoring sweep needing the literal in `serve.ts`'s own source — died at `1ca763b60` (#12533, [PR #12582](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12582)), which taught `resolveIdentifier()` to follow an import alias into a sibling module. That hop is pinned against the **real** `tenancy-posture-hints.ts`, not inferred from resolver code.
- ⭐ **Measured: no reason survives for the literal living in `serve.ts` specifically.** The sweep was the only thing in the tree reading that file's *source* for a package spelling; the roster pin, site 8 and doctor's leg (ii) all read the *value* and are alias-safe.
- ⛔ **But "possible" is not "decided."** [PR #12532](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12532) shipped the duplication deliberately, with the reasoning written at both ends. Reversing a deliberate decision is not something an execution lane takes on its own, however green the path looks.

Two constraints outlive the decision either way, and are now recorded in the code:

1. The static keeps its **NAME** — the roster pins address `Serve.ORGANIZATIONS_RUNTIME_PKG`; only a spelling may move.
2. The gap is ⛔ **never** closed in the other direction. `os doctor` must not depend on a `serve` command's export to spell a package name — #12464's coupling ruling, which the resolver hop did not touch.

⚠️ And if the reversal is taken, **site 8 of `serve-organizations-message-spelling.test.ts` falls with it** — it asserts the two declarations are equal, so it loses its subject when there is only one. ⛔ It must not be deleted *before* then: while two declarations exist the pin has a job.
